demo.description: Accounts, leads, campaigns, and team records are stored in your own Convex database. Website, CRM, product, and support signal connectors are not wired up yet, so the activity timeline shows seeded starting signals until those integrations are added.

team.title: Team and workspace access
team.description: Separate internal workspace access from customer buying-group roles, then give each teammate the tools and information required for their job.

team.inviteDemoHint: This creates a real team member record in your workspace. The invited person is linked to it automatically the first time they sign in with this email address — no invitation email is sent yet.

roleDescriptions.ownerAdmin: Controls organization settings, data connections, members, roles, and all growth operations.
roleDescriptions.cmo: Reviews acquisition cost, pipeline, conversion, retention, and lifetime value without operational clutter.
roleDescriptions.marketingManager: Runs campaigns, coordinates journeys, qualifies accounts, and manages approvals and activation programs.
roleDescriptions.socialMediaUser: Manages daily social interactions, creates and schedules posts, tags contacts, and flags high-intent conversations.
roleDescriptions.socialMediaManager: Creates and schedules content, manages comments, and monitors channel-level engagement.
roleDescriptions.sales: Works high-intent accounts, buying groups, demos, pipeline, and recommended commercial actions.
roleDescriptions.customerSuccess: Guides activation, adoption, account health, expansion, and renewal after the sales handoff.
roleDescriptions.support: Resolves customer blockers and surfaces service signals that may affect activation, health, or renewal.
